forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {弾|はじ}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to flick, to flip, to snap
definitions.explanation: To strike something with a quick, sharp motion of the finger or a similar small object.

definitions.gloss: to repel, to splash off, to shed
definitions.explanation: For a surface to cause water, dirt, or other substances to bounce off or not penetrate.

definitions.gloss: to calculate, to work out on an abacus
definitions.explanation: To do calculations, originally referring to using an abacus, now used more broadly for quick mental or rough calculations.

examples.japanese: ⟦おでこ→おでこ：09111_odeko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{弾|はじ}かれた。
examples.english: I got flicked on the forehead.
I flicked the crumb off the table with my finger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撥水|はっすい}→撥水：16444_hassui⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}く⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: If you use a water-repellent spray, it will shed rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}いて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見積|みつも}り→見積り：04699_mitsumori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I'll work out the cost before giving an estimate.

examples.japanese: そろばん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}く。
ざっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{弾|はじ}いた⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧、⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧くらい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: From a rough calculation, the cost will probably be around one million yen.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}く.

HOMOGRAPH NOTE:
Do not confuse with {弾|ひ}く (to play a stringed instrument), which uses the same kanji but a different reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{弾|はじ}く: to flick with a finger
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}く: to repel water
- そろばん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}く: to use an abacus; to calculate
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}く: to work out the cost

USAGE:
Sense 3 originates from the physical act of operating abacus beads. In modern usage, そろばん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}く can also mean "to calculate profit/loss" with a connotation of shrewdness.
